CREATE FUNCTION parity_irrelevance() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN NEW.irrelevance_for_retention := get_byte(decode(md5(NEW.event_id::text), 'hex'), 0); RETURN NEW; END $$
CREATE TRIGGER parity_irrelevance BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON events_event FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION parity_irrelevance()
